sn14.35:1.2: yo bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātuṃ abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
sn14.35:1.3: yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn14.35:1.6: yo vāyodhātuṃ abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
sn14.35:1.7: yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn14.35:2.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātuṃ na abhinandati dukkhaṃ so na abhinandati.
sn14.35:2.2: yo dukkhaṃ na abhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn14.35:2.5: yo vāyodhātuṃ na abhinandati dukkhaṃ so na abhinandati.
sn14.35:2.6: yo dukkhaṃ na abhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmīti.
